reviews.title: A great NVME drive if you're on a tight budget and need plenty of storage
reviews.comment: I bought this for a budget gaming PC that I was building for myself. I was having trouble finding one that affordable and had good ratings,  but I came across this model during Prime Day for $40. So far, I have no complaints with its functioning. It is fast for a Gen 3 model and significantly faster than the older SATA SSD that I had on my previously gaming PC. It was easy to install and completely compatible with my Gigabyte motherboard. The 1 TB capacity is more than enough for my usage (some gaming and photo editing) If there are any issues, I will make sure to update this review. If you're on a tight budget and need a reliable NVMe drive with enough storage, then I would definitely recommend giving this one a try.
reviews.author: Sean M.
